page.notes: The left margin carries a mark "3." above the note "De morte Christi pro omnibus." The second margin note, "Prosper A. Aquitanicus", is badly worn; the reading of the abbreviated name is doubtful and is marked [?]. The small marks "ʒʒ" at the left of the italic quotation lines are printer's quotation ornaments, not text, and are not transcribed. The printed "cap.pri-mum" and "Quòd" are as printed.
